serp.note: Official. Free $0 (5 MB uploads, 7-day history, 10 guests, AI trial). Plus $10/member/mo yearly (5 GB uploads, 30-day history, AI trial). Business $20/member/mo yearly (5 GB uploads, 90-day history, unlimited guests, Full AI incl. Agents + Meeting Notes + Ask Notion). Enterprise custom with zero-retention AI option.

SERP #1. Confirms Free/Plus($10)/Business($20)/Enterprise with 'Is it worth it' framing. Notes Plus has 30-day history, Business has SAML SSO + private teamspaces + 90-day history + full Notion AI (Agents, Meeting Notes, Ask Notion).

Confirms $10 Plus / $20 Business and 10-seat annuals ($1,200 vs $2,400). Flags Custom Agents at '$10 per 1,000 Notion credits' pooled across workspace. 50-user annuals: $6,000 Plus vs $12,000 Business.

Frames the Plus-to-Business decision as the hinge: Business adds Notion AI + SAML SSO + private teamspaces + 90-day history over Plus. Flags 'every editor is billed' and 20-person Business = $4,320/yr.

Price table: Free $0, Plus $10 yearly/$12 monthly, Business $20 yearly/$24 monthly, Enterprise custom. Notes 20% premium on monthly billing. Flags Custom Agents '$10 per 1,000 credits' on top of seat fees.

Confirms AI add-on retirement: 'full AI access (AI Agents, Ask Notion) now requires the Business plan at $20/user/month'. Teams previously paying $10 Plus + $10 AI now must upgrade to Business for same AI.

Notion AI pricing deep dive. Confirms Free/Plus trial only; Business ($20) and Enterprise have full AI. Custom Agents on '$10 per 1,000 credits' separate pool. Verdict: worth it only when team uses AI weekly.
True-cost table: 5 members ($600 Plus / $1,200 Business), 10 members ($1,200/$2,400), 20 members ($2,400/$4,800). Custom Agents = '$10 per 1,000 credits, workspace-wide, monthly reset, no rollover'.

'Costs nobody mentions' angle. Confirms May 2025 AI add-on retirement, 20% monthly premium, $8/mo per published custom domain. Old 1,000-block cap on 2+ member free workspaces is no longer on current pricing page.

Confirms Plus $120/yr/user, Business $240/yr/user — $120/user/yr delta is the real decision. 4.5/5 rating. Notes 'May 2026 update introduced metered Custom Agents using Notion credits ($10 per 1,000 monthly credits)'.

Competitor-authored (Nuclino) but still useful: confirms 5 MB upload cap on Free, 7-day history, 10 guests. Business has '1,500 Standard credits and 500 Select credits per member' monthly. Flags Plus-to-Business $10-to-$20 gap as 'steep'.

factcheck.claim: Notion's four 2026 tiers at list are Free $0, Plus $10/member/mo billed yearly ($12 monthly), Business $20/member/mo billed yearly ($24 monthly), and Enterprise on custom quote.
Full Notion AI (Notion Agent, AI Meeting Notes, Ask Notion, Enterprise Search) is bundled only into Business and Enterprise as of 2026; Free and Plus get a limited trial.
The standalone $8/member/month Notion AI add-on was retired in the May 2025 pricing restructure and folded into Business — Plus users can no longer add AI à la carte.
Custom Agents inside Business run on a separate workspace credit pool priced at roughly $10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits, with monthly reset and no rollover.
Notion Free offers 5 MB per-file upload cap, 7-day page history, 10 guests, and a limited Notion AI trial.
